channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: A legacy AI component was removed from the system and its references were cleared from the documentation, and storage handling was improved with better tracking of archived data and cleanup processes. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor tools were enhanced with new lockout scenarios, script fixes, and extra testing, while the SDK added a payout address feature and a numeric keypad component; supporting libraries were also cleaned up. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The project confirmed that the latest milestone met all requirements and archived related files; new functions for retrieving payout addresses and tracking earnings were added, and request handling was improved with an idempotency key. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Security was strengthened by hashing passwords and adding rotating refresh tokens, and the system now supports service registration; build processes were forced to use self‑hosted machines, and the dashboard design was updated for better accessibility. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was fixed to ensure they are stored securely, and tests were added to verify the change. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
